$comment: Every category the sample church adds to Rock, in one tree per kind of thing it holds (decision 185). The church's own data views live under one parent, Rock Solid Church, with a child for each purpose, so they never mix with the views Rock ships. Add a child here (for example Communications, Care, or Reporting) before adding data views for a new purpose. Communication list categories stay flat, like Rock's own Public category. 'entityType' is the Rock entity the category holds. 'qualifierGroupType' limits a Group category to one group type, the way Rock's category picker on Communication Lists does. 'parent' is another category's key. Categories always load, with the church setup.

categories.name: Rock Solid Church
categories.description: The church's own data views. Each child category holds the views for one purpose.

categories.name: Group Sync
categories.description: Data views that keep a communication list or security role in sync through Rock's Group Sync job.

categories.name: Care
categories.description: Private lists staff use to follow up with people, such as first-time guests and people who have not been back in a while.

categories.name: Staff
categories.description: What the church shows about each staff member, such as on a staff page: their staff photo, title, department, campus, bio, and favorite quote, plus their supervisor and start date for staff only.
